items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1965-09-13
items.q: The name 'Alvin' appears only in the interviewer's closing remark: 'Okay. Thanks a lot, Alvin.' There is no mention of Alvin by the interviewee or any description of a relationship between Armand Hug and Alvin.

ctx.x: Well, I think, Charlie, that first of all, you really have to like what you're doing, which is most important. And I have liked music, I've liked jazz music all my life, been around many, many greats, and I feel quite flattered to be associated with these people. And I'm really, really proud of the reputation that I have around New Orleans as a Dixieland jazz piano player, or whatever they want to call me, ragtime. It's still jazz. And especially when they associate it with New Orleans, it's very flattering. And…
Thank you. Thanks a lot. Thanks a lot. Thanks a lot.
